package: ASCII numeric string (meaning unproven; candidate revision)
repeated u32 LE compressed length, u32 LE inflated length, zlib data; end of package
body: recursive list: u16 LE number of children, then child records
record: u8 kind (1 directory, 0 file), u16 LE name length and name
directory: nested child list; file: u16 LE source-path length and source path, u32 LE byte length and data, then nested child list (zero in observed files)

Source-path strings are not emitted by the probe and must not be trusted as filesystem paths.

Nonzero trailing body data is rejected by this research probe, not proven invalid for all possible packages.
Different raw name encodings can produce the same displayed path; raw hex components retain identity, but a production alias-resolution policy is not implemented.

limitations: The tested packages contain binary .geo entries. No mesh, topology, UV, material graph, transforms, controls, or flight behavior was decoded or validated.
Named airfoil and engine values appear in .mod but these packages do not include matching .sim files; exact lookup locations and semantics remain unresolved.
Unclassified/opaque .mod and .bmp-named bytes in Yak sample were not decoded or worked around.
ZIP downloads and creator posts do not grant universal redistribution or commercial licenses.
A .pkg can bundle many livery files for one aircraft; counting them as separate aircraft is unsupported.
PKG numeric labels correlate with MOD revisions; their field meaning and encoding-version semantics remain unproven.
The probe is capped to an observed research profile. Rejection is not proof that an unrecognized file is invalid Phoenix data.
